g.title: cluster_notes
g.text: WHY A VIEW, NOT A TABLE

g.title: n1
g.text: • Edges are FULLY DETERMINED by paths → storing both invites drift.
• A narrator's teachers are per-(hadith, sanad) facts, NOT narrator attributes:
a self-FK teacher_narrator_id cannot model M:N-per-chain.
• Direction: position runs in propagation order, so
from = teacher (earlier), to = student (later) — matches MIS convention.
• Global teacher/student network = GROUP BY from_narrator, to_narrator.
• Upgrade path if hot: MATERIALIZED VIEW + REFRESH after seed.

g.title: n2
g.text: a chain slot may name someone with no profile row.
The link still exists as a positional fact —
raw_name always carries the chain string.
